thread.title: Millennials are loading up on Apple ahead of earnings (AAPL)

author: EGFZE
title: Millennials are loading up on Apple ahead of earnings (AAPL)
text: Apple is set to report earnings after the bell, Thursday.Investors will be watching the iPhone X sales numbers and the company's forward-looking guidance. Watch - Apple - Shares - Trade - Time Watch Apple shares trade in real time here.Apple is set to report its holiday-quarter earnings Thursday, and millennials can't get enough of the stock. Robinhood - Trading - App - Millennials - Investors On Robinhood, the trading app popular with millennials, young investors are buying shares of Apple 78% more often than they are selling them. The stock was also the most held stock on Robinhood, according to Shrey Shahi, head of data science at Robinhood.Shahi said that the enthusiasm for the company could be stemming from the flagship iPhone X. Apple's Thursday report will be the first to include sales of the new phone. Last quarter, young investors on Robinhood were selling shares 20% more often than...
